tax.text: Davies said she supports lowering taxes and preserving Proposition 13.
tax.quote: As your Assemblywoman, I have and will continue to support policies that: lower taxes; preserve Proposition 13;

wages.text: Davies twice voted against AB 1228, which established a higher minimum wage for fast-food workers.
wages.quote: Noes Alanis, Megan Dahle, Davies, Dixon, Essayli, Flora, Vince Fong, Gallagher, Hoover, Lackey, Mathis, Jim Patterson, Joe Patterson, Sanchez, Ta, Waldron, Wallis

schools.text: Davies introduced AB 1786 to require transfer options for certain low-performing public-school students.
schools.quote: This bill would require a school district of residence to also approve an intradistrict transfer request for a low-performing pupil

safety.text: Davies opposes defunding the police and supports maintaining enough trained and equipped police in every community.
safety.quote: I oppose ‘Defunding the Police.’ I believe we need to do what it takes to have enough well-trained, properly equipped police in every community.

sentencing.text: Davies said she supports stopping the early release of convicted felons.
sentencing.quote: promote safe neighborhoods and parks; resolve the homelessness crisis; and stop the early release of convicted felons.

abortion.text: Davies voted against SCA 10, which proposed a state constitutional right to reproductive freedom.
abortion.quote: Noes Bigelow, Choi, Cunningham, Megan Dahle, Davies, Flora, Fong, Gallagher, Kiley, Lackey, Mathis, Nguyen, Patterson, Seyarto, Smith, Voepel, Waldron

health.text: Davies voted against advancing AB 1400, the Guaranteed Health Care for All single-payer proposal.
health.quote: Ayes Bryan, Calderon, Gabriel, Holden, Levine, McCarty, Mullin, Quirk, Luz Rivas, Robert Rivas, Stone Noes Bigelow, Davies, Fong

energy.text: Davies said gasoline should be made more affordable and opposed regulations she blamed for higher prices.
energy.quote: The fact is we need to be making gasoline more affordable and all these rules and regulations are the reason gas is $1 more expensive here in California than anywhere else in the nation.

voting.text: Davies voted against SB 1174, which prohibited local governments from requiring voter identification.
voting.quote: Noes Alanis, Chen, Megan Dahle, Davies, Dixon, Essayli, Gallagher, Hoover, Lackey, Mathis, Jim Patterson, Joe Patterson, Sanchez, Ta, Waldron, Wallis
